resources.string: Lo mshini wokukala umfutho wegazi awusekeli ukubuyekeza isikhathi ngokuzenzakalelayo. Setha isikhathi sawo mathupha.
Isikhathi somshini wokukala umfutho wegazi asikwazanga ukubuyekezwa. Hlola noma usethe isikhathi emshinini wakho.
Izilinganiso zilondoloziwe, kodwa umshini wokukala umfutho wegazi awuqinisekisanga ukuthi ukudlulisa kuphelile. Xhuma kabusha ngaphambi kokungenisa futhi.

Ihlola yonke indawo yenkumbulo yomshini, hhayi lezo kuphela ezibika njengezisetshenzisiwe. Yisebenzise uma kubonakala sengathi izilinganiso ezithile azikho. Kuthatha isikhathi eside, ngakho gcina umshini useduze kuze kuphele.
Uhlu lomshini alukwazanga ukusetshenziswa; yonke indawo ifundiwe.
Umshini awubikanga zilinganiso ezigciniwe. Sebenzisa u-Funda konke uma ulindele ezithile.
Indawo yesibili yenkumbulo okungenzeka le modeli ingenayo yeqiwe.
